mechanism: NSAIDs like celecoxib may increase risk of neuroleptic malignant syndrome (NMS) and impair renal function, while fluphenazine increases CNS depression and antipsychotic effects; additive effects on fluid retention and hypotension are possible.
action: Monitor for signs of NMS (fever, rigidity, altered mental status), renal function, and blood pressure; use lowest effective NSAID dose and consider alternative analgesics if prolonged use is needed.
